chiSym q (chainProd (q - q⁻¹) (List.map (sbar σ (q - q⁻¹)) Ps)) * chiSym q (chainProd (q - q⁻¹) Ps) = chiAlt q (chainProd (q - q⁻¹) (List.map (sbar σ (q - q⁻¹)) Ps)) * chiAlt q (chainProd (q - q⁻¹) Ps)

theorem QOU.WedderburnMass.s_invariant_ansatz_captures_S_odd_iff {B : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [CommRing R] (S : B → B) (A Φ₁ Φ₂ Φ₃ V : B → R) (α c h2 : R) (hA : ∀ (β : B), A (S β) = A β) (h2e : ∀ (β : B), Φ₂ (S β) = Φ₂ β) (h3o : ∀ (β : B), Φ₃ (S β) = -Φ₃ β) (hV : ∀ (β : B), V (S β) = V β) (β : B) :
V (S β) - V β = massS A Φ₁ Φ₂ Φ₃ α c h2 (S β) - massS A Φ₁ Φ₂ Φ₃ α c h2 β ↔ α * (Φ₁ β - Φ₁ (S β)) + 2 * α * h2 * Φ₃ β = 0
